task.title: Tighten the workspace restore path
task.description:
Restoring a workspace after a crash currently replays every pane in the order it was written, so a pane that fails to mount blocks the ones behind it.

## Expected

- Each pane restores independently.
- A pane that cannot mount is reported inline and skipped.
- The remaining panes still reach their saved size.

## Notes

The restore order is only meaningful for focus, not for layout. See the linked issue for the original report and the recorded session.

```
restore(panes) -> settle(layout) -> focus(lastActive)
```
